data.name: Dramaturgical Flourish
data.description: At 2nd level and every 2 levels thereafter, an argent dramaturge's studies into the history and structure of stories grant her access to secret performances, allowing her to select an option from the list of dramaturgical flourishes below. Unless otherwise noted, an argent dramaturge cannot select a dramaturgical flourish more than once.
